text:
On a routine season we read your message, and an experienced planner looked into it. We understand that your complaint concerns the care and handling of your companion animal during travel and that the experience left you disappointed and worried.

We are sorry that the service did not meet the standard you expected from Aurelia Skyways. The Companion Animal Travel Desk treats each report with care because animals travel best when the process is calm, clear, and attentive. In this review, we checked the booking notes, the handoff steps, and the remarks from the ground team so we could understand where the service broke down. Our aim is to restore confidence by addressing the concern directly and by improving the way our teams coordinate before departure and at arrival.

When a traveler entrusts us with a pet, we expect our staff to follow the established routine without added stress or confusion. If a delay, a missed update, or a rough transfer affected your pet's journey, that is not the level of care we want to provide. We will pass the matter to the relevant supervisors so they can review the handling process, reinforce the proper checks, and make sure the next review is handled with greater consistency. If further assistance is needed, our desk will remain available to continue the case through the normal escalation path.

We appreciate that these situations can feel personal, especially when a companion animal is involved. Your feedback helps us improve the service we give to travelers and their animals across our skyports, and we value the opportunity to address your concern with seriousness and respect. We hope future travel with Aurelia Skyways will show the attention and reliability that you should be able to expect.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
